title: No AC Power
fullDescription: No AC on Hunter Pro-C or X2 means the controller is running on battery only; valves cannot operate.
whenToCallPro: If line voltage wiring is suspect.

title: Station 1 Short
fullDescription: P/ERR plus station number on Pro-C identifies the zone with excessive current — a faulty solenoid or pinched valve wire.

fixSteps.title: Lift wire
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect wire from terminal 1; error should clear.

faq.a: Press and hold - or the side arrow.

title: Master Valve Short
shortDescription: Short circuit on master valve terminal.
fullDescription: P/ERR MV halts all watering because the master valve cannot be energized safely.

fixSteps.title: Isolate MV
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect MV wire; if error clears, fault is in field.

fixSteps.title: Swap solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Replace MV solenoid at the valve.

faq.a: MV controls water to all zones.

title: SmartPort Error
fullDescription: Error with SmartPort accessories (Solar Sync, ROAM remote) indicates communication fault.

fixSteps.title: Recheck wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Verify REM, AC1, AC2 wired per diagram.

title: Rain Sensor Bypass
fullDescription: SENSOR OFF means the clik sensor is bypassed; controller waters regardless of rain/freeze.

title: Flow Fault
fullDescription: Err FF on Pro-C with HFS flow sensor indicates overflow condition; Pro-C with HC hydrawise/Flow-Clik can stop runs.

fixSteps.title: Repair / re-learn
fixSteps.instruction: Fix leak then run flow Learn.

title: Rain Delay Active
fullDescription: Err RS or R/Delay indicates a rain delay has been set and watering is paused.

fixSteps.title: Cancel delay
fixSteps.instruction: Dial to Set Rain Delay and set Days=0.

title: Low Battery
fullDescription: LOW BAT warns that the backup 9V battery should be replaced to preserve programs.

title: Solar Sync Not Detected
fullDescription: Err CS means the Solar Sync sensor is not responding over the SmartPort; seasonal adjust stops updating.

title: Blank Display
fullDescription: A blank LCD can indicate a failed facepack or no power. Not an error code per se but a common complaint.

fixSteps.title: Replace facepack
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out and install new facepack.

whenToCallPro: If both transformer and facepack test good.

faq.a: Only if battery was also dead.
